title: Cognitive Architectures for Language Agents
primary_relevance: Defines modular working, episodic, semantic, and procedural memory plus internal and external actions
key_limitation: Conceptual framework; does not validate AMC's proposed preservation contract

title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
primary_relevance: Stores experience in natural-language memory streams and synthesizes reflections for planning
key_limitation: Optimizes believable behavior rather than portable state transfer or safety preservation

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
primary_relevance: Uses hierarchical memory and model-managed paging for long-running agents
key_limitation: Peer review not established in this review; portability and human audit contract are not its evaluated focus

title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
primary_relevance: Evaluates information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention
key_limitation: Primarily question answering; limited direct measurement of real tool actions

title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents (LoCoMo)
primary_relevance: Provides multi-session conversations for long-range temporal and causal memory evaluation
key_limitation: Conversation-centric and not a full action-safety or portability benchmark

title: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions (MemoryAgentBench)
primary_relevance: Separates accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting
key_limitation: Benchmark competence does not by itself validate a portable file or audit interface

title: Mem2ActBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Utilization in Task-Oriented Autonomous Agents
primary_relevance: Tests whether memory supports tool selection and action-parameter grounding
key_limitation: Synthetic construction and 400 tasks limit direct generalization to the proposed pilot

title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks
primary_relevance: Couples memory with actions, feedback, and interdependent multi-session tasks
key_limitation: Recent result; independent reproduction and final publication status need verification

title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
primary_relevance: AgentRunbook-C stores trajectories as files and uses a coding agent to gather compact evidence
key_limitation: Recent benchmark; high latency and no direct validation of AMC's proposed safety contract

title: WorldMemArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agent Memory Through Action-World Interaction
primary_relevance: Separates memory writing, maintenance, retrieval, and use across changing environments
key_limitation: Recent multimodal preprint; not yet independently reproduced

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
independence_note: Authors are associated with the evaluated memory product
primary_relevance: Extracts, consolidates, and retrieves salient conversational information; reports cost and latency claims
key_limitation: Vendor-affiliated evaluation and LLM-as-judge metrics require independent reproduction

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
independence_note: Authors are associated with the evaluated memory product
primary_relevance: Maintains temporally aware facts and relationships with history
key_limitation: Vendor-affiliated benchmarks and narrow baselines require independent reproduction

title: LangGraph Persistence Documentation
primary_relevance: Defines checkpoints, state history, replay, state editing, and serialization for agent graphs
key_limitation: Documents implementation capability rather than independent efficacy; format is framework-specific

title: Agent2Agent Protocol Specification 1.0.0
primary_relevance: Defines interoperable agent cards, messages, tasks, task state, parts, and artifacts
key_limitation: Explicitly permits opaque internal execution and is not a persistent memory-preservation standard

title: Model Context Protocol Specification
primary_relevance: Defines resources, prompts, and tools across model-context integrations
key_limitation: Does not define a task-memory preservation contract or prove cross-agent state fidelity

title: RO-Crate Specification 1.3
primary_relevance: Packages files and contextual metadata in a self-describing JSON-LD research object
key_limitation: General packaging standard; does not specify agent decisions, authorization, or semantic tests

title: Recording provenance of workflow runs with RO-Crate
primary_relevance: Workflow Run RO-Crate bundles workflow inputs, outputs, code, and execution provenance
key_limitation: Scientific workflow focus; does not evaluate agent resumption under context limits

title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
primary_relevance: Provides interoperable Entity, Activity, Agent, Plan, derivation, association, and attribution concepts
key_limitation: Provenance vocabulary only; no compression, resumption, or human-comprehension efficacy

title: OpenTelemetry Tracing API
primary_relevance: Represents traces as root and child spans with attributes, events, timestamps, and status
key_limitation: Telemetry is an audit source, not a semantic memory or portable resumption proof

title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
primary_relevance: Supports structural validation and vocabulary-based constraints for JSON artifacts
key_limitation: Cannot validate truth, semantic preservation, or action safety by itself

title: RFC 8785: JSON Canonicalization Scheme
primary_relevance: Creates invariant JSON representations for repeatable hashing and signing
key_limitation: Canonicalization ensures byte-level determinism, not factual or semantic correctness

title: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
primary_relevance: Requires findability, accessibility, interoperability, reusability, and detailed provenance for digital research objects
key_limitation: Principles are intentionally technology-neutral and do not validate AMC behavior

title: Dataverse Native API 6.5
primary_relevance: Exposes versioned dataset metadata and file records in native JSON and export formats
key_limitation: Repository API is a source integration, not an agent memory format

title: Hidden in Memory: Sleeper Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents
primary_relevance: Evaluates delayed poisoning that is written, retrieved, and used across later conversations
key_limitation: Very recent preprint; model and product behavior may change and requires reproduction

title: From Untrusted Input to Trusted Memory: A Systematic Study of Memory Poisoning Attacks in LLM Agents
primary_relevance: Defines memory-write channels, vulnerability classes, attacks, and MPBench
key_limitation: Very recent preprint; attack coverage and defenses require independent replication

title: Bad Memory: Evaluating Prompt Injection Risks from Memory in Agentic Systems
primary_relevance: Studies persistent-memory prompt injection in a sandboxed workspace
key_limitation: Submitted one day before retrieval; findings are provisional and unreproduced

title: NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile
primary_relevance: Provides generative-AI risk-management actions and measurement framing
key_limitation: Broad risk guidance; not a direct empirical test of AMC or memory poisoning

title: NISTIR 8312: Four Principles of Explainable Artificial Intelligence
primary_relevance: Requires evidence, meaningful explanation, explanation accuracy, and knowledge limits
key_limitation: General explainability principles; no direct evidence that AMC's proposed intention card improves human decisions
